item.title: WATCH | Fenech Adami warns Malta joining Board of Peace goes against spirit of neutrality
item.description: Opposition foreign affairs spokesperson Beppe Fenech Adami says Malta accepting to join Donald Trump’s Board of Peace goes against spirit of neutrality • Carmelo Abela says United Nations needs to take more frontline approach on Palestine

item.title: 01.tech launches a next-generation game aggregator for iGaming projects
item.description: 01.tech has launched a flexible, enterprise-grade game aggregator designed to help iGaming studios and operators streamline integrations, customise content portfolios, and scale efficiently across multiple jurisdictions

item.title: WATCH | Gozo Bishop under fire for condemning childcare centres
item.description: Gozo Bishop Anton Teuma says parents who send babies to childcare centres see them as objects

item.title: Call for applications for two judges issued
item.description: Ministry for Justice issues call for applications for the appointment of two judges

item.title: Valletta blocked as cement mixer gets stuck in Old Bakery Street
item.description: The mixer and growing traffic jam are located in the middle of three construction sites with cranes, leaving the cars no room to leave Old Bakery Street

item.title: Advocates chamber slams premature public discussion of potential nominees for chief justice
item.description: Public debate over the appointment of Malta’s next chief justice prompts concern from Chamber of Advocates, which warned that the process risks being politicised as prospective candidates’ names are aired before cross-party agreement is reached

item.title: Court rejects Abbazia’s constitutional challenge over Nadur land deregistration
item.description: First Hall of the Civil Court rules government’s legislative intervention to deregister vast tracts of land in Nadur was a proportionate measure serving the ‘general interest’ despite evidence of political pressure on the Land Registry

item.title: 82-year-old struck by car rushed to hospital
item.description: Man, 82, suffers serious injuries after getting hit by car in Żabbar

item.title: Prime Minister denies agreeing to keep chief justice nominee secret, Alex Borg responds
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela claims Opposition Leader Alex Borg had trouble convincing 'third parties' to accept Judge Consuelo Scerri Herrera's nominee for chief justice • Borg warns against such discussions being politicised

item.title: Government received 800 submissions on White Rocks, Fort Campbell, Manoel Island consultation
item.description: Environment Minister Miriam Dalli refutes the notion that the projects show that open spaces are an afterthought for government, as major greening projects promised before the 2022 election remain incomplete
